tickets.title: Complete one-time IRA withdrawal for remodel deposit
tickets.text: Process a $38,000 gross distribution from Dorian Pebblefizz's traditional IRA at Velvet Acorn Custody to Teacup Comet Bank checking for the first contractor deposit on the home accessibility remodel.
tickets.evidence: Dorian asked for a $38,000 gross distribution from the traditional IRA at Velvet Acorn Custody to be sent to Teacup Comet Bank checking for the first contractor deposit, and they agreed to complete the one-time IRA withdrawal by 2025-08-15.

tickets.title: Change recurring payment instructions
tickets.text: Confirm the requested recurring payment change, verify the effective timing with the provider or custodian, and document the old and new payment method or amount without storing unnecessary sensitive details. Increase Dorian Pebblefizz's regular IRA distribution at Velvet Acorn Custody from $4,000 to $6,500 gross per month into Teacup Comet Bank checking, and document the revised bank destination and withholding assumptions before the next payment cycle.
tickets.evidence: Dorian also asked to raise the regular IRA cash flow from $4,000 gross per month to $6,500 gross per month and to document the revised bank destination and withholding assumptions before the next payment cycle; they agreed to complete the recurring IRA distribution adjustment by 2025-08-20.

tickets.title: Complete address and residency update workflow
tickets.text: Use this workflow when Dorian and Elena Pebblefizz report a new mailing address, tax residency change, seasonal residence, or household relocation. Confirm the effective date, update advisory records, and identify planning consequences for tax-aware investment management, retirement income distributions, and account communications. Update Dorian and Elena Pebblefizz's advisory records, mailing information, meeting location notes, and retirement distribution withholding assumptions for the June 2025 move from Portland, Oregon, to Henderson, Nevada.

subTasks.title: Confirm move details and documentation
subTasks.text: Collect the new mailing address, physical residence, prior address, effective date, seasonal residence notes, and any supporting documentation the client is comfortable providing.

subTasks.title: Update internal records and communication preferences
subTasks.text: Update CRM, household profile, statement delivery preferences, meeting location notes, and any compliance-required address fields.

subTasks.title: Review planning impacts
subTasks.text: Check whether the move affects state tax assumptions, retirement distribution withholding, municipal bond exposure, estate document jurisdiction, insurance coverage, or advisor registration requirements.

subTasks.title: Confirm completion with client
subTasks.text: Send a brief confirmation summarizing the updates made and any follow-up items the client should address with tax, legal, or account providers.

tickets.evidence: The move from Oregon to Nevada requires advisory records, mailing information, meeting location notes, and retirement distribution withholding assumptions to be updated using the new residency facts Dorian provided, and they agreed to complete those updates by 2025-08-22.
